name: 5-MeO-MsBT
summary: 5-MeO-MsBT, also known as 5-methoxy-N-methyl-N-sec-butyltryptamine, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 5-methoxytryptamine families. It emerged as a novel designer drug online in December 2022. More specifically, its chemical synthesis and the claimed properties and effects of 5-MeO-MsBT were posted on a specialized psychoactive drug forum.
